# 00 — Logo forensics & vector reconstruction spec

**Source:** `docs/assets/logo-original.png` — the new official emblem supplied by the school (1254 × 1254 px, RGB, JPEG-derived raster with mild ringing around edges).
**Result:** `public/brand/*.svg` + `src/brand/seal-geometry.json`, generated by `scripts/brand/build-logo.mjs`.

## 1. Anatomy

The mark is a **circular seal** in three concentric zones:

| Zone | Content | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Outer band | Two equal-width rings: **red** outside, **blue** inside, each with a hairline black keyline | Red + blue on white reads as the Romanian *and* Transylvanian-Saxon colour pairing (Saxon red/blue). No yellow band. |
| Legend field (white) | Upper legend clockwise: „Colegiul Național” (roman) · **„Johannes Honterus”** (Fraktur, ≈1.5× larger) · „-Naționalkolleg” (roman). Lower legend counter-clockwise, read left→right: „Brașov ✶ Kronstadt” | Romanian + German name of the school, Romanian + German name of the city. The star separator is a six-spoke asterisk. |
| Centre | **The Kronstadt arms**: a crown whose stem ends in roots (*Corona* — the city's canting arms), drawn as a 16th-century **woodcut** inside a Renaissance **cartouche shield** with four volutes (two at the top, two at the bottom, two lateral scrolls) and a small suspension ring at the top | Dense parallel hatching, white highlights on the right half (light from the right), root system fanning across the lower field. This is the signature element: Honterus himself was a woodcut artist and printer (Kronstadt press, 1539). |

### Measured geometry (normalised to a 1000 × 1000 viewBox)

The raster is slightly off-centre and very slightly elliptical (scanner/export artefact). True centre measured from the ring edges at 0/90/180/270°: **(625.5, 618.5) px**, outer radius **≈ 601 px** → scale factor `k = 480 / 601 = 0.7987`.

| Element | Value (viewBox units) |
|---|---|
| Outer ring radius | 480 |
| Ring width (red, blue) | 25 each (red 480→455, blue 455→430) |
| Keylines | 1.6 at r = 480 and r = 430 |
| Upper legend baseline | r = 343 |
| „Colegiul Național” | 204° → 141° (math angles, CCW from 3 o'clock), roman, size 56 |
| „Johannes Honterus” | 139.5° → 37°, Fraktur, size 84, baseline −2 |
| „-Naționalkolleg” | 36° → −24°, roman, size 56 |
| Lower legend | baseline r = 384, centred at 276°, span 62°, roman size 48 |
| Crest bounding box | x 281.5–728.1, y 230.9–787.8 (aspect ≈ 0.80) |

### Colours (sampled, flat areas, median)

| Token | Sampled | Hex |
|---|---|---|
| Seal red | rgb(196, 8, 23) | `#C40817` |
| Seal blue | rgb(0, 31, 119) | `#001F77` |
| Ink | near-black | `#111111` (master) / `#14171F` (UI ink) |
| Field | white | `#FFFFFF` |

## 2. Typography in the mark

- **Roman legend:** a Times-style transitional serif (bracketed serifs, moderate contrast). Rebuilt with **Liberation Serif** (Times-metric) — glyphs are converted to outlines, the font is not shipped to browsers.
- **„Johannes Honterus”:** a Fraktur with a swashed *J* and a looped *H*. Rebuilt with **UnifrakturMaguntia** (OFL). The original letterforms differ slightly in the capitals (the original *H* is more ornate); proportions, baseline, weight and span match within ±2 units.
- Tracking in each run is solved numerically so every run spans exactly the measured angle.

> ⚠️ **Spelling observation:** the official artwork spells the German line **„Naționalkolleg”** with a Romanian *ț*. Correct German is *Nationalkolleg*. The seal reproduces the artwork faithfully (it is the official mark); all site copy uses *Honterus-Nationalkolleg*. Setting `"germanLine": "-Nationalkolleg"` in `scripts/brand/logo-params.json` and rebuilding produces a corrected seal if the school wishes.

## 3. Construction method

1. **Crest:** masked to r < 372 px (removes the legend), cropped (330, 260)–(935, 985), upscaled ×4 with Lanczos, thresholded at 140, then traced with **potrace** (`turdSize 8`, `optTolerance 0.4`, curve optimisation on). This keeps every hatch line of the woodcut as true vector geometry — hand-redrawing 1 400+ hatch strokes would only lose fidelity. A second trace of the flood-filled exterior gives the **silhouette** (`crestBack`) used as a paper backing on dark surfaces.
2. **Rings:** pure circles from the measured radii (not traced), so they are mathematically clean.
3. **Legend:** set on arcs from font outlines (see §2), coordinates rounded to 0.1 unit.
4. Verified by overlaying the render at 50 % opacity on the re-centred original (see Wave 4 visual QA).

## 4. Variants

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `public/brand/honterus-seal.svg` | Full colour master (white field, red/blue rings). Print, hero, OG image. |
| `public/brand/honterus-seal-mono.svg` | One ink (`#14171F`) on transparent — light surfaces, letterheads, watermark. |
| `public/brand/honterus-seal-mono-light.svg` | Paper-tone rings/legend for dark surfaces; crest keeps a paper backing so the woodcut never reads as a negative. |
| `public/brand/honterus-crest.svg` / `-light.svg` | Crest only (header lockup, favicon base, section marks). |
| `src/brand/seal-geometry.json` | Path data for the inline Astro component (`<Seal>`), which supports `variant`, `size` and an **ink-draw reveal** (rings drawn with `stroke-dashoffset`, legend and crest revealed by a radial mask; disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`). |
| Favicon / app icons | Derived in Wave 2: at ≤ 48 px the woodcut hatching turns to noise, so small sizes use a **hand-drawn simplified crest** (cartouche outline + crown + root fan), on the red/blue ring. |

### Clear space & minimum sizes

- Clear space: ≥ 0.12 × diameter on all sides.
- Full seal with legend: minimum **96 px** on screen (legend becomes illegible below).
- Crest only: minimum **28 px** tall; below that use the simplified favicon crest.
- Never recolour the rings except to a single ink; never stretch, rotate, outline or put the seal on photographs without a solid field behind it.

## 5. Weight budget

The master SVG is ≈ 176 KB raw / ≈ 64 KB gzip because of the woodcut detail. It is therefore **never inlined on every page**: the header uses the crest via `<img>` (cached immutable) at small size, and the full seal is inlined only where it is animated (homepage hero), loaded once and cached thereafter.
